name: sailthru-zephyr
description: Write, review and debug Zephyr personalization in Sailthru, now sold as Zeta Engage by Sailthru. Covers a syntax nothing else shares (single braces, no filter pipe, functions only), the creation-time versus send-time brace distinction, the suppression functions and why they do not stop a Lifecycle Optimizer flow, and the feed response that ships an empty email instead of cancelling
